commons_data/artifacts/manifest.json.title: The Lantern Grove
commons_data/artifacts/manifest.json.subtitle: A tiny Infinite Commons neighborhood in a very determined lunchbox.
commons_data/artifacts/manifest.json.welcome: You have found the little clearing where every traveler is a guest and every question has room to grow.

rooms.title: Lantern Clearing
rooms.description: Warm windows glow between enormous fern fronds. Four paths leave the little plaza. A paper sign reads: NO ACCOUNT REQUIRED, JUST WONDER.
rooms.discovery: A wooden sign under the lantern says: 'The forest has a network now. The forest would also appreciate it if you drank some water.'

rooms.title: Professor Phi's Library
rooms.description: A miniature library is tucked into the roots of an ancient imaginary oak. The shelves hold questions rather than personal information.
rooms.discovery: Today's field note: 'Observation is evidence, but it is not automatically the whole truth.'

rooms.title: Queso's Relay
rooms.description: A red-roofed doghouse sports an antenna made from a painted stick. The sign says: APPROVED BARKS ONLY.
rooms.discovery: Incoming message: WOOF. Integrity status: emotionally compelling, cryptographically unverified.

rooms.title: The Lunchbox Workshop
rooms.description: Inside, tiny cardboard network diagrams cover the walls. A cardboard telescope points toward tomorrow's experiments.
rooms.discovery: On the desk: 'LightBridge optical handoff is an idea to test, not a transfer performed here.'

rooms.title: Dream Pie's Garden
rooms.description: Fireflies trace gentle patterns through flowering ferns. Nothing is recorded; a story can simply be enjoyed.
rooms.discovery: A paper moon reads: 'Imagine freely. Label dreams honestly. Leave the world a little kinder.'

exits.label: Return the questions to the library
